description: This is a Java class 'UserServiceImpl' that provides service layer functionality for user management, including retrieval, deletion, listing, and saving or updating User entities. It extends a generic service implementation and implements the 'UserService' interface, utilizing dependency-injected DAO and email service components.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class handling user-related operations such as retrieval, deletion, listing, and saving or updating User entities within the application.

methods.name: UserServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UserDao dependency.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on the username.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a User entity by its ID after fetching it.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of User entities associated with a specific MerchantStore, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new User or updates an existing User entity based on the presence of an ID.
